title: The sitter in my art class had pencil lines for a face
description:
Mum always said I never finish a face. So I joined a Wednesday night portrait class and didn't tell her.

The sitter on the dais was made of raw pine, with pencil guide lines where its face should be. Every week its face looked a little more like my canvas, and every week it sat a little nearer my easel.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Would you have finished its face, or left it half done like me?
